criteria.description: Cute cat sitting serenely on the sand with distinct ears, tail curve, posture and golden eyes or rim lighting looking toward the horizon.
criteria.visual_observations: Cat is now seated gracefully with back to viewer, pointed ears upright, elegant curled tail on the left, and a vibrant golden rim light glowing on its head and spine looking directly at the sunset.

criteria.description: Vibrant sunset sky with multi-stop gradient (deep navy to warm violet, coral, golden orange) transitioning into calm ocean with sun reflection.
criteria.visual_observations: Multi-stop sunset sky gradient beautifully melts into the deep ocean with vivid golden reflection and glowing sun.

criteria.description: Warm sandy beach in the foreground with gentle contours, shoreline meeting the ocean, subtle texture or gentle waves.
criteria.visual_observations: Warm sand dunes with foam shoreline and subtle natural sea grass accents frame the scene cleanly.

criteria.description: Atmospheric evening details such as distant flying birds, faint evening stars in the upper sky, and radiant sun glow.
criteria.visual_observations: Flock of silhouettes birds, gentle stars in upper dusk sky, and concentric sun glow give strong evening atmosphere.
